extensions.prior_stage_output: cloud-ok refute BLOCKED; named probes restored
extensions.evidence_requirement_verbatim: Emit all ten pairwise set differences with counts and sample ids. Set membership is exactly the kind of question that must be answered by an algorithm rather than by reading - write the differ.
tests_required_verbatim: Known-present control: an id present in all five must not appear in any difference.
Known-broken control: delete one manifest entry and confirm exactly one difference grows by one.
Duplicate-id control: a colliding id across two registries must be reported (the duplicate-catalog failure class).
Empty-input control: run against an empty registry and confirm it reports total divergence rather than agreement.

named_probe_contract.name: NAMED PROBE 1: TEN PAIRWISE SET DIFFERENCES WITH COUNTS AND SAMPLE IDS
NAMED PROBE 2: ALGORITHMIC SET-MEMBERSHIP CONTROLS AND RECOMPUTATION

extensions.set_membership_rule: Only explicit registry ids are members; receipt existence is keyed by on-disk filename stem. Missing registries are empty sets plus structural defects, never inferred data.
extensions.completion_marker_protocol: Literal Unicode NEL delimiters expose the required exact line through splitlines while preserving valid JSON.
